items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: "He said, 'Yeah, Gates, you gotta come with me.' I said, 'All right,' ... I figured here's a big-name..."

ctx.x: He had heard you at the Congo?
Yeah. That's where he heard me. He said, "Yeah, Gates, you gotta come with me." I said, "All right," "so... Me like a dummy, I was saying, "Yeah, I guess I will." I figured here's a big-name...
Right. This is your first really big name.
